scripts.docker:install: docker compose run --rm app npm install
scripts.docker:prisma:generate: docker compose exec app npx prisma generate
scripts.docker:prisma:migrate: docker compose run --rm app npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.docker:prisma:deploy: docker compose run --rm app npx prisma migrate deploy
scripts.docker:prisma:seed: docker compose run --rm app npx ts-node --project prisma/tsconfig.json prisma/seed.ts
scripts.docker:prisma:studio: docker compose exec -d app npx prisma studio
scripts.docker:test: docker compose exec app npm test
scripts.docker:test:auth: docker compose exec app npm test tests/auth-diagnosis.test.ts
scripts.docker:test:e2e: docker compose exec app sh -c 'grep -R ADMIN_PASSWORD_HASH .'
scripts.docker:reset: npm run docker:clean && npm run docker:prisma:migrate && npm run docker:prisma:seed && npm run docker:up

prisma.seed: prisma generate && npx ts-node --project prisma/tsconfig.json prisma/seed.ts
